verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product with a CLI, a web UI, and GitHub PR integration, so cross-device task continuity is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents starting a task, such as a CLI review or chat session, on one device and resuming it from another device or browser. PR reviews living on GitHub or cubic.dev is a property of the host platform, not a documented session-handoff capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
